summary.headline: Planetary Applications and Angular Effects
summary.text: Astrological judgments on planetary applications: Mars, Venus, and Mercury produce specific effects on health, wealth, enemies, sexuality, reputation, and affairs. The passage also explains the effects of luminaries and malefics in angular places, and the Moon’s influences by sign, configuration, and conjunction.
